ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/grey) pixel distribution concentrated in mottling and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigment field across both lobes; diffuse grey-white mottling on the right lobe's distal region; isolated high-contrast white circular spots located near the median notch and outer right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations; right lobe shows major jagged indentations (possible tissue loss) while the left lobe displays a more frequent, lower-amplitude serration pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge sweep transitioning to a convex distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, high-contrast white circular clusters (~5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the ventral surface, notably one large focal point on the central-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal white linear disruptions visible on the lower-left lobe quadrant, oriented approximately 45 degrees to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular trailing edge trauma on the right lobe characterized by large, jagged excavations of the fluke margin; white scarring visible along the inner edges of these indentations.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, deep rectangular notch-like indentation on the upper distal edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serrations.
